items.question: What mobile app development services does WrathCode Technology offer?
items.answer: WrathCode Technology offers custom mobile app development, Android and iOS applications, business mobile apps, eCommerce apps, on-demand platforms, UI/UX design, API integration, testing, deployment, and maintenance tailored to your business goals and technical requirements.

items.question: How much does it cost to develop a mobile app?
items.answer: Mobile app development costs depend on application complexity, features, design, backend infrastructure, and integrations. Basic apps generally cost less than advanced platforms with real-time features or payment processing. Contact WrathCode Technology for a project-specific estimate.

items.question: How long does it take to develop a mobile application?
items.answer: Development timelines depend on project scope, functionality, design requirements, and technical complexity. Basic applications may take several weeks, while feature-rich platforms can require several months. We establish realistic timelines after evaluating your requirements.

items.question: Which technologies do you use for mobile app development?
items.answer: We use Kotlin, Java, Swift, and suitable cross-platform frameworks based on your project requirements. Our development process also includes backend technologies, databases, REST APIs, and third-party integrations to create secure, scalable mobile applications.

items.question: Can you develop a custom mobile app for my business?
items.answer: Yes. We develop custom mobile applications for startups, small businesses, and enterprises across various industries. From business management and eCommerce platforms to booking applications and workflow automation, we tailor features to your operational needs and business objectives.

items.question: Can you integrate APIs and payment gateways into a mobile app?
items.answer: Yes. We integrate mobile applications with REST APIs, backend systems, databases, authentication services, payment gateways, maps, and third-party platforms, focusing on secure data communication, reliable functionality, and seamless user experiences.

items.question: Will my mobile application be secure and scalable?
items.answer: We follow security-conscious development practices and scalable architecture principles. Depending on your requirements, our approach may include secure API communication, authentication, access controls, data protection, input validation, and performance testing.

items.question: Do you develop both Android and iOS applications?
items.answer: Yes. We develop Android applications for Android devices and iOS applications for Apple devices. Based on your target audience, budget, features, and business goals, we recommend a suitable development approach for a consistent, user-friendly mobile experience.

items.question: Do you help publish apps on the Google Play Store and Apple App Store?
items.answer: Yes. We assist with production builds, app signing, release configuration, store listing assets, and submission requirements for the Google Play Store and Apple App Store. Publication depends on meeting platform policies and approval requirements.

items.question: Do you provide mobile app maintenance and support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide ongoing mobile app maintenance, including bug fixes, performance optimization, security improvements, operating system compatibility updates, and feature development to keep your application reliable and aligned with evolving business requirements.

items.question: Can you upgrade or improve an existing mobile application?
items.answer: Yes. We improve existing Android and iOS applications through UI/UX redesign, technical troubleshooting, performance optimization, new feature integration, code modernization, and compatibility improvements based on your goals and technical requirements.

items.question: Do you develop mobile apps for startups and small businesses?
items.answer: Yes. We work with startups, small businesses, and established enterprises to create applications aligned with their budgets, priorities, and growth plans. We identify essential features and establish development priorities to support future expansion.

items.question: How can I start a mobile app development project with WrathCode Technology?
items.answer: Contact WrathCode Technology to discuss your app idea, target audience, required features, budget, and timeline. Our team evaluates your requirements, recommends a suitable development approach, and outlines the next steps for your custom mobile app development project.
